parsed.text: Summary: Current records (represented_time 12 in several inherited/copy origins) show concentrated distributions at node n1 in both panels: blue peaks at cell [1,0] and red peaks at [0,2]; other current nodes are uniform in most panels except panel p1 node n0, where the current view places blue mass on four cells {[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]} and red mass on four cells {[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]}. Conditional command candidates (k0,k1,k2, represented_time 13 for command estimates) are alternative, not executed, branches. Differences across command records: for node n0, k0 is uniform, k1 concentrates blue on the top-right quadrant and red on the top-left quadrant, and k2 concentrates blue at [0,2] and red at [0,0]. Nodes n1,n2,n3 show the same peaks across views where indicated. Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional records are counterfactual/conditional, not events that have occurred.
